{"id": "2d780906-0e37-4f66-aff7-3203bf254659", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "In this account's us-east-1 data, Bedrock spend hasn't gone up this month. It's well below October. The only model that grew is Nova Lite, and it's small. Cost Explorer shows a few of the models below by their legacy names.

**Model usage (Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Service line items)**

| Model | Oct 2026 | Nov 1–23 |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Sonnet 5 | $51.56 | — |
| Claude Opus 4.8 | $11.65 | — |
| Nova Lite | $0.05 | **$0.73** |
| Claude 4.6 Sonnet | $0.10 | — |
| Claude 4.5 Sonnet | — | $0.002 |
| Palmyra X5 | — | $0.003 |
| Guardrails | ~$0.02 | ~$0.004 |
| **Total** | **~$63.4** | **~$0.74** |

**AgentCore (Runtime vCPU and memory)**
- October was $48.60, with vCPU at $42.19 and memory at $6.40.
- November so far is $13.06, all vCPU.

**What this shows**
- **Nova Lite** is the only model whose cost rose, from about $0.05 to $0.73. It's now the largest model line item this month, but it's under a dollar.
- **Claude Sonnet 5** and **Opus 4.8** drove the October spend, and neither has any usage so far in November.
- AgentCore vCPU is the biggest Bedrock-related cost this month at $13.06.

**Why this may not match your bill**
- This is account 123456789012 in us-east-1 only. If the jump is in another region or a linked account, it won't show here.
- The figures are unblended and don't include credits or discounts.
- Cost Explorer can lag by up to a day, so the last day or so of November may be missing.
- Anthropic and other third-party models can also be billed through AWS Marketplace. I didn't see Marketplace line items here, but that would be one place to look.

I can run the same breakdown across all regions, or across linked accounts if this is a payer account. Tell me which you want.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
